  • International military moves: CENTCOM chief scheduled to meet IDF Chief to solidify Lebanon ceasefire/withdrawal planning. Germany and Israel conducting a joint naval exercise off Haifa.
  • Backchannels / communications: Swiss talks established a communication channel with Iran.
  • Air/movement indicators: Continued military air traffic detected in region (multiple military RCH flights logged).
  • Good News: Diplomatic channels opened — Swiss-Iran line; CENTCOM-IDF engagement; Germany-Israel naval exercise; formal pause announced (window for de-escalation if honored).

Threat assessment: Escalating
